hypothesis: Queue-normalized v7 and hard-negative LightGBM scores make complementary top-20 errors on the same frozen groups.
evaluation_cohort: 68 historical holdout queues, previously exposed in earlier research
normalization: average ascending rank percentile within each queue
selection: maximum validation Recall@20 among blends with validation P@10 at least v7; ties select the lower hard40 weight
acceptance: On historical holdout, Recall@20 and P@10 must both improve over v7; group purity is fixed. All-499 descriptive values are reported but not used for selection.
